hook.line: Everyone in La Candelaria has a story about when something happened: when the café opened, when the neighbourhood changed, when their parents met. You need a way to say "back in the sixties" without giving a year.
hook.es: Rosa abrió el café a mediados de los sesenta.
hook.en: Rosa opened the café in the mid-sixties.

examples.es: Mis papás se conocieron a finales de los setenta.
examples.en: My parents met in the late seventies.

examples.es: Esa canción era famosa en los años ochenta.
examples.en: That song was famous in the eighties.

examples.es: La casa se construyó a principios del siglo XX.
examples.en: The house was built in the early 20th century.

examples.es: Rosa abrió el café a mediados de los sesenta.
examples.en: Rosa opened the café in the mid-sixties.
What were you doing in the nineties? (to a friend)

rule:
For a decade, say *en los años ochenta*, or shorter, *en los ochenta*. The number stays as it is: no *-s*, no apostrophe.

To say early, middle or late, use:
*a principios de* (early)
*a mediados de* (mid)
*a finales de* (late)

Then the period: *a finales de los setenta*, *a mediados de 2015*, *a principios del siglo XX*. Remember *de* plus *el* becomes *del*.

Centuries are written in Roman numerals but said as ordinary numbers: *siglo XX* is *siglo veinte*.
smallPrint: Teachers call *principios, mediados, finales* time expressions for locating a point inside a period.

readAndPick.es: Mis papás se conocieron a finales de los setenta.
options: My parents met in the early seventies.
My parents met in the mid-seventies.
My parents met in the late seventies.

readAndPick.es: Rosa abrió el café a mediados de los sesenta.
options: Rosa opened the café in the early sixties.
Rosa opened the café in the mid-sixties.
Rosa opened the café in the late sixties.

readAndPick.es: Esa casa es del siglo veinte.
options: That house is from the nineteenth century.
That house is from the twentieth century.
That house is from the twenty-first century.
I moved at the start of 2015.
I moved in the middle of 2015.
I moved at the end of 2015.

readAndPick.es: Mi papá nació a finales de los sesenta.
options: My dad was born in the late seventies.
My dad was born in the late sixties.
My dad was born in the early sixties.

readAndPick.es: La casa se construyó a principios del siglo XX.
options: The house was built at the end of the 20th century.
The house was built in the middle of the 20th century.
The house was built at the start of the 20th century.

options: I moved to Bogotá in the middle of the year.
I moved to Bogotá at the end of the year.

options: My grandmother arrived in Bogotá fifty years ago.
My grandmother arrived in Bogotá in the sixties.
My grandmother arrived in Bogotá in the fifties.

yourTurn.prompt: Pick and type the whole sentence: *Mis papás se conocieron ___ los setenta.* (*a finales de* or *a principios de*) My parents met in the late seventies.
yourTurn.answer: Mis papás se conocieron a finales de los setenta.
yourTurn.why: *Finales* means the end of a period, so "late".

yourTurn.prompt: Pick and type the whole sentence: *La casa es ___ siglo veinte.* (*de el* or *del*) The house is from the twentieth century.
yourTurn.answer: La casa es del siglo veinte.

yourTurn.prompt: Say: My dad was born in the late sixties.
yourTurn.answer: Mi papá nació a finales de los sesenta.
yourTurn.why: *A finales de* plus *los sesenta*, with no *-s* on the number.

yourTurn.prompt: Say: I moved to Bogotá in mid-2015.
yourTurn.answer: Me mudé a Bogotá a mediados de 2015.
yourTurn.why: *A mediados de* works with a year just as it does with a decade.

yourTurn.prompt: Ask a friend: What were you doing in the nineties?
yourTurn.why: *Años* can stay or go: *los años noventa* and *los noventa* mean the same.

yourTurn.prompt: Make it shorter: *Esa canción era famosa en los años ochenta.* Drop the word for years.
yourTurn.answer: Esa canción era famosa en los ochenta.
yourTurn.why: In everyday Spanish, *los ochenta* is enough.

yourTurn.prompt: Change early to mid: *Rosa abrió el café a principios de los sesenta.*
yourTurn.answer: Rosa abrió el café a mediados de los sesenta.
yourTurn.why: *Mediados* is the middle of a period, so "mid".

pitfalls.why: Almost. A decade number never takes an *-s* in Spanish.

pitfalls.wrong: Se conocieron a final de los setenta.
pitfalls.right: Se conocieron a finales de los setenta.

pitfalls.wrong: Se construyó a principios de el siglo XX.
pitfalls.right: Se construyó a principios del siglo XX.

personal: Say when something true about your family happened, using *a principios de*, *a mediados de* or *a finales de*, like *Mis abuelos se casaron a mediados de los cincuenta*.
